title: Spikers' Turf: NU sweeps ProVolley Australia to stay unbeaten in semis

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Jade Disquitado unloaded 22 points to keep National University-Archipelago Builders unbeaten in two games in the semifinals round of the Spikers’ Turf Invitational Conference, sweeping ProVolley Academy of Australia, 25-23, 25-21, 25-15, on Wednesday at FilOil EcoOil Centre in San Juan City. Disquitado, the MVP in their previous V-League title run, continued to push the Bulldogs to another finals bid with 19 kills and three aces to go with 20 excellent receptions out of 26 attempts. RK Medino chipped in 10 points. Buds Buddin had nine points and seven digs, while Obed Mukaba and Peng Taguibolos added seven […]...
